title: Our Future Health — Linked health records data — Cancer treatment at tumour level — warning checks
description: Non-blocking checks for the nhse_eng_canreg_pattumour table, from rules the source does not state but the steward accepted (D129). A finding is a warning for analysts and data providers: it never rejects a row and never changes data. Run tools/warn.py; the main schema and tools/validate.py are unaffected.

allOf.$comment: Warning R197: the tumour site is not prostate (not C61) but a Gleason score is not 8; Gleason is a prostate score and the source labels 8 "not applicable".
